description:
Bodyweight lives on the Body screen and strength on Trends, so the one question that needs both — is this a real strength gain or am I just heavier — cannot be asked.

Plot a strength trend against the bodyweight trend on a shared time axis. This is the thing a single-user app can do that a social one cannot, and the roadmap names it as the differentiation thesis. Two series with unrelated units on one chart is the hard part; a second axis is a lie unless both scales are stated.
title: Put bodyweight next to strength on one view
